mapping.summary: Style, colour and size matrix product management for apparel brands, generating BC items or variants.
claims: A style is defined once and its colours and sizes generate items or item variants
Matrix cells can be created one by one, in bulk or by Excel import
SKU numbering global, per style or by pattern, with GTIN pools and check-digit validation
Attributes at style, colour or SKU level with storefront translations and a completeness score
Image references with roles, approval and licence expiry
Tracks certifications with expiry and a role centre cue for those about to lapse
Groups styles into seasons, drops and capsules with stock, on-order and open sales rollups
A collection can be cloned for the next season
Bulk SKU status changes are logged per batch and reversible
Blocks reuse of retired SKU codes
Personalisation BOMs capture embroidery, monograms or thread colours on the sales order
REST endpoints for all main entities for storefronts, 3PLs or integration platforms
Dedicated permission sets for apparel users
No dependency on other apps and no external service calls for its features
30-day free trial, then licensed directly by Equerra
BC online, Essentials or Premium, version 28.2 or later
